pages.title: Safe from Your Attacks
pages.text: A Guardian Tag protects your dragon from damage caused by you, its owner.

pages.title: Known to Its Owner
pages.text: The tag recognizes the dragon's current owner and works in either form. Other attackers and environmental hazards can still hurt it.

pages.title: Crafting the Tag
pages.text: In any crafting-table column, place dragon bone, a name tag, and any dragon scale from top to bottom.
